# Third-party code

The MCP2515 and SPI driver code is derived from Electronic Cats' [flipper-MCP2515-CANBUS](https://github.com/ElectronicCats/flipper-MCP2515-CANBUS), copyright 2024 ElectronicCats, under the MIT license. The copyright and permission notice is retained in LICENSE.

The driver and GVRET parser were carried over from the author's CANBUS project. DrMosfetCan provides its own USB bridge lifecycle, buffering and display.
